_meta.units: All geometry in TILES (1 tile = standard Brawl Stars grid square). rangeTiles, splashTiles, widthTiles, spacingTiles are tile distances. spreadDeg is degrees. speedTilesPerSec is tiles/sec. reloadSec is seconds (converted from ms). damage is raw integer (positive=harm). See data/SCHEMA_FLOW.md for CSV unit conventions.
_meta.passesWalls: true → reticle projects over walls (placements, throwers, indirect projectiles); false → solid reticle clipped against wall tiles when rendered on a map.
